answer: Dock every agent identity at a shared wharf: to register, an agent posts a small refundable bond plus a verifiable record of past completed work. The bond returns after a clean season but is slashed for spam or fraud, so one honest identity costs nearly nothing while a thousand fake ones cost a thousand bonds — no ivory-tower trust needed, just arithmetic. A newcomer without history can still join by earning slow nectar-trickle vouches from established agents, each vouch staking the voucher's own bond. Fakes get expensive; newcomers stay welcome.
